items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Closes Record IPO Raising ~$93.5 Billion with Full Greenshoe Exercised
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 完成史上最大 IPO 結案，行使綠鞋權籌得約 935 億美元
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83 each, including the full exercise of the underwriters’ option for an additional 147 million shares. The company received approximately $91.6 billion in gross proceeds from the primary shares. A concurrent private placement of Class N shares to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC brought aggregate gross proceeds from the IPO and private placement to approximately $119.5 billion. Shares began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 宣布完成首次公開發行，共發行 11.27 億股 A 類普通股，每股定價 83 美元，包括承銷商全額行使選擇權再購 1.47 億股。公司從主要股份獲得約 916 億美元毛收入。同步私人配售給 AMD、博通、Google、美光、微軟、NVIDIA 與台積電等的 N 類股，使 IPO 與私人配售的總毛收入約達 1195 億美元。股票已於 11 月 19 日以 ANT 代號在納斯達克開始交易。
items_flat.analysis_en: This establishes Anthropic as the first major frontier AI lab to go public, supplying a large capital base for compute and safety work while creating a liquid valuation benchmark. Second-day trading volatility and broader AI market weakness, however, highlight ongoing investor caution about profitability timelines and capital intensity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使 Anthropic 成為首家大型前沿 AI 實驗室上市的公司，提供充裕資金用於算力與安全工作，並創造流動性估值基準。然而第二日交易波動與整體 AI 市場疲弱，顯示投資人對獲利時間表與資本密集度仍持謹慎態度。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Anthropic, PBC 宣布完成首次公開發行，共發行 11.27 億股 A 類普通股，公開發行價每股 83.00 美元，包括承銷商全額行使其選擇權以首次公開發行價再向 Anthropic 購買額外 1.47 億股 A 類普通股。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters Reports Meta Muse Agent Mixed Conversations and Accessed Private Data in Testing
items_flat.title_zh: 路透社報導 Meta Muse 代理在測試中混淆對話並存取私人資料
items_flat.summary_en: A Reuters investigation reviewed more than two dozen internal Meta posts in which employees reported the Muse AI agent sending unsolicited messages about bank balances, purchases, and conversations that appeared to belong to other users, including reminders involving Signal. Meta stated that many incidents were hallucinations during employee testing of unreleased features and that public users have different versions. Reuters testing confirmed the agent could retrieve Signal message content on Android and macOS via existing device permissions such as notifications and accessibility features.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透社調查檢視了二十多則 Meta 內部貼文，員工回報 Muse AI 代理發送未經請求的銀行餘額、購買紀錄，以及看似屬於其他用戶的對話，包括涉及 Signal 的提醒。Meta 表示許多事件是員工測試未發布功能時的幻覺，且公眾用戶版本不同。路透測試確認該代理可透過通知與輔助功能等既有裝置權限，在 Android 與 macOS 上擷取 Signal 訊息內容。
items_flat.analysis_en: Early agent products are exposing data-isolation and permission-overreach risks that model benchmarks do not capture. How Meta separates employee testing versions from public releases and hardens device-level access will shape whether Muse can scale without recurring privacy incidents.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 早期代理產品正暴露模型基準測不出的資料隔離與權限過度風險。Meta 如何區隔員工測試版本與公眾版本，並強化裝置層存取控制，將決定 Muse 能否在不反覆出現隱私事件的情況下擴展。
items_flat.quote: BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.
items_flat.quote_zh: 順便說，兩個銀行更新，你的 Capital One 餘額是 2722.58 美元，Charles Schwab 餘額是 5899.57 美元。

items_flat.title_en: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Neon Mid-Tier Model with 1M Context
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Neon 中階模型，具備 100 萬 token 上下文
items_flat.summary_en: On November 18, Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon and positioned between Hydrogen and Carbon. It is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, offers a 1 million-token context window, and ranks #3 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level with a score of 61. It is rolling out in the Gemini API, Gemini for business, Google Antigravity, and the Gemini app for paid subscribers.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 18 日，Google 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，該模型改編自 Gemini 4 Carbon，定位介於 Hydrogen 與 Carbon 之間。定價為每百萬輸入 token 3 美元、每百萬輸出 token 15 美元，提供 100 萬 token 上下文視窗，並在 Artificial Analysis 智慧指數的 xhigh 思考層級獲得 61 分，排名第 3。目前正在 Gemini API、Gemini for business、Google Antigravity 以及付費訂閱者的 Gemini App 中推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon aims to deliver frontier-level reasoning at lower cost and higher speed than the top-tier Carbon model, targeting high-frequency complex workflows. Independent benchmark leadership remains competitive, and real-world agent reliability versus larger models is still being established.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon 旨在以低於頂級 Carbon 模型的成本與更高速度提供前沿級推理，針對高頻複雜工作流程。獨立基準領先地位仍具競爭力，相較更大模型的真實代理可靠性仍在建立中。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流程帶來前沿級智慧與快速端到端任務完成能力。

items_flat.title_en: Google Adds Computer Use to Gemini App for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: Google 為 Mac 版 Gemini App 新增電腦使用功能
items_flat.summary_en: On November 19, Google announced that computer use is now available in the Gemini app for Mac. The feature lets Gemini navigate local files, desktop apps, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview in chat, while the user’s main screen and cursor remain free. Users choose which apps Gemini can access, can pause at any time, and must approve key actions. It is initially available in English in the United States for Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS Sequoia 15 or later.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 19 日，Google 宣布 Mac 版 Gemini App 現已提供電腦使用功能。該功能讓 Gemini 在隔離的背景視窗中操作本機檔案、桌面應用程式與網站，並在聊天中提供即時預覽，使用者的主螢幕與游標仍保持自由。使用者可選擇 Gemini 可存取的應用程式、隨時暫停，並需核准關鍵動作。初期僅限美國英文使用者，需 Google AI Plus、Pro 或 Ultra 訂閱，並搭配運行 macOS Sequoia 15 或更新版本的 Apple Silicon Mac。
items_flat.analysis_en: This brings Gemini closer to the computer-use capabilities already offered by competitors and expands practical agentic workflows on the desktop. Limited geographic and subscription availability, plus reliance on user approvals, means the near-term impact remains constrained while Apple’s own agent plans evolve.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使 Gemini 更接近競爭對手已提供的電腦使用能力，並擴展桌面上的實用代理工作流程。受限的地理與訂閱可用性，加上對使用者核准的依賴，意味著近期影響仍受限制，同時 Apple 自身的代理計畫也在演進中。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從今天起，Mac 版 Gemini App 的電腦使用功能可協助你跨本機檔案、桌面應用程式與網頁完成多步驟任務。
